decisions.reason: Organic sliced ham sits squarely in the firm's core cured-meat competence, so it can interpret retail feedback and adjust the recipe or format from existing knowledge, and organic SB packs fit a growing segment.
Organic Kasseler uses the firm's established curing and smoking know-how, and the organic line shares sourcing and certification knowledge, keeping learning costs low.
Pepper salami is a classic variant of the firm's raw-sausage expertise, and in organic form it extends a line the firm can readily assimilate and improve.

The exotic teriyaki aspic specialty for the service counter departs from familiar flavour knowledge and depends on a counter channel weakened since 2020, making its results harder to interpret and the product a likely candidate for removal.
Fennel salami (finocchiona style) builds on salami production know-how, but as a niche flavour variant its uncertain demand makes it vulnerable in a range review.
A classic liver pâté with veal fits the firm's existing cooked-sausage and pâté competence, so early results are easy to read and the product can be refined internally.
